rationale: The proof concerns rho_tau throughout, and tau is a one-argument functional; the unsubscripted rho and two-argument tau(u,v) contradict the defining formula immediately above.
Each tau_i is an F-seminorm on U, not a two-argument function; the Cauchy criterion in 2A5G uses tau_i(u-v).
The quantified tail statement is for every n greater than or equal to m; its norm must therefore use u_n, not the fixed threshold term u_m.
